_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. xpFactor 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Harvest at the Ruebenfeld, the peasant-onboarding chore gate (GDD 5). ⚑ QUESTS: offers and turns in `turnip-chore` — its target species is only damageable by the `harvest`-tagged aura he teaches, which is why the quest brief points back at his teaching row — and `boars-in-the-field` (plan-generic-kill-quests.md C1), the first second quest on one giver; each quest sits behind its own root row per the Q4 tree shape. ⚑ TEXT SHAPE (PO 2026-08-02, on top of the Q4/R1 tree shape): quest and teach text is deliberately plain — no lore or stylized wording yet. Teaching is behind a root 'Teach me something.' row leading to a teachings node whose row NAMES the skill directly. Quest rows carry NO quest_at_stage gate — a row is shown iff its ledger op would succeed (the Q1 show-rule).
